The timeout is marshaled through HTTPX request extensions into HTTP Core; HTTP Core does not receive timeout values in `ConnectionPool` construction. In the stated versions, an explicit `httpx.Timeout(timeout=None)` should propagate `None` for all four operations, so a genuine ~5-second `ReadTimeout` indicates that the request was built with HTTPX’s default timeout configuration instead of the explicit object—typically due to a caller/version integration issue at HTTPX’s request-building boundary.

Relevant files:

- [sg-evals/httpx--0.27.0:httpx/_config.py?L194-L260](/r/github.com/sg-evals/httpx--0.27.0/-/blob/httpx/_config.py?L194-L260) - `Timeout` fields (`connect`, `read`, `write`, `pool`), explicit `None` normalization, `as_dict()`, and validation requiring either a default or all four fields.
- [sg-evals/httpx--0.27.0:httpx/_config.py?L367-L370](/r/github.com/sg-evals/httpx--0.27.0/-/blob/httpx/_config.py?L367-L370) - `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_CONFIG = Timeout(timeout=5.0)`, used when no client timeout is supplied.
- [sg-evals/httpx--0.27.0:httpx/_client.py?L1576-L1626](/r/github.com/sg-evals/httpx--0.27.0/-/blob/httpx/_client.py?L1576-L1626) - `AsyncClient.stream()` builds the request, sends it with `stream=True`, and exposes the response iterator.
- [sg-evals/httpx--0.27.0:httpx/_client.py?L1630-L1675](/r/github.com/sg-evals/httpx--0.27.0/-/blob/httpx/_client.py?L1630-L1675) - `AsyncClient.send()` preserves streaming and therefore timeout failures can occur later while iterating `resp.aiter_bytes()`.
- [sg-evals/httpx--0.27.0:httpx/_transports/default.py?L89-L104](/r/github.com/sg-evals/httpx--0.27.0/-/blob/httpx/_transports/default.py?L89-L104) - `HTTPCORE_EXC_MAP`, including `httpcore.ReadTimeout -> httpx.ReadTimeout`.
- [sg-evals/httpx--0.27.0:httpx/_transports/default.py?L354-L382](/r/github.com/sg-evals/httpx--0.27.0/-/blob/httpx/_transports/default.py?L354-L382) - `AsyncHTTPTransport.handle_async_request()` creates `httpcore.Request` and passes `request.extensions` unchanged; this is the HTTPX→HTTP Core timeout marshaling boundary.
- [sg-evals/httpx--0.27.0:httpx/_transports/default.py?L248-L255](/r/github.com/sg-evals/httpx--0.27.0/-/blob/httpx/_transports/default.py?L248-L255) - `AsyncResponseStream.__aiter__()` maps exceptions while response body chunks are consumed.
- [sg-evals/httpcore--1.0.5:httpcore/_models.py?L321-L355](/r/github.com/sg-evals/httpcore--1.0.5/-/blob/httpcore/_models.py?L321-L355) - `Request` stores the incoming `extensions`, including the timeout dictionary.
- [sg-evals/httpcore--1.0.5:httpcore/_async/connection_pool.py?L43-L61](/r/github.com/sg-evals/httpcore--1.0.5/-/blob/httpcore/_async/connection_pool.py?L43-L61) - `AsyncConnectionPool` constructor; notably, it has no timeout parameters.
- [sg-evals/httpcore--1.0.5:httpcore/_async/connection_pool.py?L159-L197](/r/github.com/sg-evals/httpcore--1.0.5/-/blob/httpcore/_async/connection_pool.py?L159-L197) - `handle_async_request()` extracts only `timeout["pool"]` for connection acquisition, then forwards the unchanged request to the selected connection.
- [sg-evals/httpcore--1.0.5:httpcore/_async/connection.py?L67-L106](/r/github.com/sg-evals/httpcore--1.0.5/-/blob/httpcore/_async/connection.py?L67-L106) - connection dispatch and `_connect()`, which extracts `timeout["connect"]` and passes it to the network backend.
- [sg-evals/httpcore--1.0.5:httpcore/_async/http11.py?L179-L210](/r/github.com/sg-evals/httpcore--1.0.5/-/blob/httpcore/_async/http11.py?L179-L210) - HTTP/1.1 response headers/body paths extract `timeout["read"]` for each read operation.
- [sg-evals/httpcore--1.0.5:httpcore/_async/http11.py?L216-L226](/r/github.com/sg-evals/httpcore--1.0.5/-/blob/httpcore/_async/http11.py?L216-L226) - `_receive_event()` passes the read timeout to `AsyncNetworkStream.read()`, where backend timeout enforcement raises `httpcore.ReadTimeout`.
- [sg-evals/httpcore--1.0.5:httpcore/_async/http11.py?L147-L168](/r/github.com/sg-evals/httpcore--1.0.5/-/blob/httpcore/_async/http11.py?L147-L168) - request header/body paths extract and apply `timeout["write"]`.
- [sg-evals/httpcore--1.0.5:httpcore/_async/connection_pool.py?L191-L198](/r/github.com/sg-evals/httpcore--1.0.5/-/blob/httpcore/_async/connection_pool.py?L191-L198) - pool dispatch into `connection.handle_async_request()`, completing the pool→connection path.
